newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline flat to lower on softer crude, unleaded.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline flat to lower on softer crude, unleaded.

text.p: NWE gasoline was flat to slightly weaker on Wednesday as sickly crude and unleaded futures continued to weigh on the market, traders said.
Eurograde barges traded at least five times at $197 a tonne fob ARA, with one player picking up four of the parcels. It was talked around the $195/$197 level later on.
Prompter Eurograde material traded $193.25 fob ARA and was talked around $193/$194.
Traders said weak crude and gasoline futures continued to keep the lid on the market. NYMEX May unleaded futures were 0.67 cent lower at 61.10 cents a gallon lower at 1755 GMT.
On the cargo front, traders said very little had been done since the $197 cif NWE deal done for 10,000 tonnes on Tuesday.

The market continued to keep an eye out for arbitrage opportunities to the United States, but most said the current unleaded prices kept the door firmly shut. -- Melanie Goodfellow. London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
